CFB-week.summary: Thin prop board: only ECU-Memphis and Duke-Virginia had posted player lines (Covers odds table, 10 lines). Memphis is a 9.5-10.5 point home favorite; Jaylin Carter's workload (19 and 23 carries the last two games) is the clearest volume edge, with Burnside and Stokes overs and an Emory Williams passing-yards under as smaller plays.

NBA-CLE-at-PHI-1022.summary: Philadelphia's home opener comes two nights after a 106-100 win at New York in which LeBron James played as a facilitator and rebounder rather than a main scorer. Cleveland opens its season with Jarrett Allen questionable (right patellar tendinopathy); if he sits, Mobley moves to center and Tyson starts. Philadelphia is still without three bigs (Hukporti, Barlow, Fall), and Wade is questionable. Market has PHI around -3 (opened -4.5) with the total up from 233.5 to about 236.

NBA-DEN-at-OKC-1023.summary: OKC hosts Denver after a 116-104 opening win at San Antonio Tuesday (one day of rest, no back-to-back); Denver is playing its first game. Previews have OKC -8.5 with a total near 235.5, both starting fives healthy, Strawther out and Spencer Jones questionable for Denver, Topic, Sorber and Oweh out for OKC. OKC lost Dort, Wiggins and Joe this offseason, and McCain (20 points) and Wallace (starting at SG) have taken on bigger roles.

NBA-HOU-at-SA-1024.summary: San Antonio opened with a coach-confirmed three-guard lineup (Fox, Castle, Harper) plus Vassell and Wembanyama while Tobias Harris (calf) sat, and lost 116-104 to OKC. Fox and Harper shared playmaking (7 and 5 assists), leaving Castle as a scorer (24 pts, 1 ast) and Vassell squeezed (7 pts, 3 reb). Harris's return date is open, which could shift roles again.

NBA-NY-at-BOS-1023.summary: Both teams lost their openers Tuesday: Boston blew a 22-point lead at Detroit, and the champion Knicks lost 106-100 to Philadelphia. The Celtics are about 2.5-point home favorites with a total near 223.5. Boston traded Jaylen Brown for Paul George (38 in his debut) and keeps Pritchard as sixth man; Carter (mono) is out, Robinson tweaked an ankle but called it minor, and the Knicks have no injuries listed.

NFL-NE-at-CHI-1023.summary: Caleb Williams is back from his hamstring (30/36 in his return), Monangai is out again, and New England is without three cornerbacks (Davis, Prunty, Canada) and both starting guards, so the Patriots may live in base/three-safety looks. Chicago is missing LBs Sanborn and Edwards (doubtful) and Montez Sweat (suspension); Bears about -2.5/-3, total 50.5, mild weather.

NBA-DAL-at-HOU-1022.summary: Fred VanVleet is back from the ACL tear that cost him all of 2025-26: he had 17 points and 7 assists in the preseason opener against Dallas. Tari Eason is healthy as the first player off the bench. The app's last-10 numbers for Durant and Jabari Smith come from games without VanVleet, so their playmaking and touches could shrink. Dallas is missing Lively, Aldama and Martin.

NBA-GS-at-LAL-1022.summary: Golden State opens short-handed: Podziemski, Porzingis, Butler and Moody are out, and Curry is probable after an ankle sprain in Sunday practice, with Kerr saying he will play. The Lakers list Collin Sexton as questionable.

NBA-IND-at-NO-1022.summary: Tyrese Haliburton returns for his first regular-season game since his 2025 Finals Achilles tear and is not on the injury report; the packet's Indiana starters omit him. McConnell and Nesmith are out, so Kelly Oubre Jr. likely fills wing minutes. Dejounte Murray is expected back from a toe contusion for New Orleans under new coach Jamahl Mosley.

NBA-PHX-at-POR-1022.summary: Portland opens as a 2.5-point favorite (total 231.5) with Damian Lillard back from his Achilles and starting next to Ja Morant. Deni Avdija is questionable with right ankle soreness; if he sits, Jrue Holiday likely joins a three-guard lineup and Vit Krejci gets more wing minutes. Holiday comes off the bench and sat the preseason finale with hand swelling (X-ray negative).

NBA-SAC-at-LAC-1022.summary: The Clippers start without Bradley Beal (knee), Max Strus (plantar fascia) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser. Rui Hachimura was their top scorer in preseason. Sacramento is thin up front without Cardwell and Raynaud, and Monk is questionable.

best.why: Monangai is ruled out for a third straight game, and Swift has handled 16 and 20 carries as the lead back in that stretch. Chicago is a short home favorite that leans on the run, and previews favor his attempts over his yardage because his efficiency has been uneven. Roschon Johnson's share is the main risk.
